AC.description: Documentation of a grant, revocation or change of access rights on a platform, including changes made outside Steward. Documenting freezes the entry; another person can verify it.

platform.label: Platform
platform.help: Id of the Steward platform whose access changed

subjectId.label: Subject id
subjectId.help: User name, user id or technical user id on the platform

rightsBefore.label: Rights before
rightsBefore.help: Roles, groups or scopes before the change, one per line

rightsAfter.label: Rights after
rightsAfter.help: Roles, groups or scopes after the change, one per line

requestRef.label: Request reference
requestRef.help: Ticket number or link, e.g. a ServiceNow request

runId.label: Run
runId.help: Run that made the change (automatic entries)

findingId.label: Reconciliation finding
findingId.help: Undocumented change this entry documents after the fact

list.emptyText: Change requests and decision records you may see will show up here.
list.emptyCreateText: Write a change request or a decision record, or import your existing decision records from Markdown files.

detail.frozen: The content is frozen: it was recorded with its hash when the record left the draft status.
detail.frozenRevisable: The content is frozen. To change it, start a new revision: the record goes back to draft and needs a new approval.
detail.tamperedTitle: The content does not match its recorded hash
detail.tampered: The record was changed outside Steward after it was frozen. It cannot be approved or moved on. Check the audit log.
detail.importedStatus: Imported from {{file}} with the status "{{status}}". Imported records start as drafts and need an approval in Steward.

versions.title: Versions
versions.author: Author
versions.onlyOne: There is only one version so far.
versions.same: The two versions have the same content.

links.title: Links
links.urlHelp: http or https, e.g. the entry in your CMDB, a ticket or a wiki page
links.label: Label

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.help: Documents and e-mails that belong to the content (PDF, images, .eml, .msg, Office files, text; up to 20 MB each). Their SHA-256 values are part of the content hash.
attachments.frozen: The content is frozen: attachments can only change in a new revision.
attachments.readOnly: Documents and e-mails that belong to the content.

transition.title: {{action}}: {{number}}
transition.approvalNote: You approve or reject exactly this content (hash {{hash}}). The decision is recorded in the audit log.
transition.freezeNote: The content is frozen from now on. Changing it later needs a new revision.

revise.title: New revision of {{number}}
revise.help: The record goes back to draft as revision {{revision}}. The frozen content stays in the version history and the audit log. It needs a new approval.
revise.reason: Why is a new revision needed?

pdf.title: PDF of {{number}}
pdf.signersHelp: People outside Steward who sign the PDF, e.g. the business owner or the requester. Each gets a signature block with an empty digital signature field.
pdf.draftWarning: This record is still a draft: the PDF is marked as such. Submit it first if the PDF is meant for signing.
pdf.created: The PDF was generated and stored with the record.
pdf.signHowTo: Send it to the signers. They sign the signature fields in Adobe Acrobat Reader or another PDF reader and send the file back. Upload the signed file on the "PDF & signatures" tab.
pdf.uploadHelp: Steward accepts a signed PDF only if it starts unchanged with a PDF generated here for the current, frozen revision of this record and every signature in it has a signature value and a complete byte range. The structure is checked; the signatures are not cryptographically validated, and the signer names are what the signing tool claims.
pdf.uploaded: The signed PDF was stored with the record.
pdf.structureOnly: Structure checked, signatures not cryptographically validated. Validate them in a PDF reader if you need to.
pdf.notChecked: Attached by an administrator without checking that it is derived from a generated PDF.

editor.title: Edit {{number}}
editor.markdownHelp: Headings with ##, lists with - or 1., **bold**, `code`, tables with |. HTML is shown as text.
editor.commentPlaceholder: What did you change? (shown in the version history)
editor.requiredHint: Fields marked with * must be filled in before the record can be submitted.
editor.frozen: The content of this record is frozen. Start a new revision to change it.
editor.notAllowed: You are not allowed to edit this record.

importer.title: Import Markdown files
importer.help: Import decision records (MADR, Nygard ADRs) or other Markdown files with YAML frontmatter. Each file becomes a draft; a status in the file is kept as a note and tag.
importer.typeHelp: For files that do not name a type in their frontmatter (type: ADR). ADRs are recognised automatically.
importer.drop: Drop .md files here (up to 20 files, 256 KB each)
importer.originalStatus: Status in the file: {{status}} (imported as draft)

types.title: Record types
types.description: Number prefix, name, workflow, template and fields of each kind of record.
types.keyHelp: Number prefix, 2–10 capital letters or digits (CR → CR-2026-0001)
types.keyLocked: The key cannot change while records of this type exist: it is part of their numbers and content hashes. Change the name instead.
types.name: Name

workflowHelp.change: Draft → Submitted → Approved or Rejected → Implemented → Closed; Cancelled from Draft or Submitted.
workflowHelp.decision: Draft → Proposed → Accepted or Rejected; Accepted → Superseded or Deprecated.
workflowHelp.access: Draft → Documented (frozen) → Verified by a second person; Cancelled from Draft.

types.workflowLocked: The workflow cannot change while records of this type exist.
types.templateHelp: The text a new record starts with, usually the section headings.
types.archiveHelp: Archived types keep their records but accept no new ones.
types.builtinHint: Built-in types are shown in each person's language as long as their texts are unchanged. Texts you change here are shown to everyone as entered.
